meta.title: Hanoi and Sapa Vietnam travel guide (itinerary and expenses) | Jen Barangan
meta.description:
Days Activities
Day 1 -7:40am - Arrival Noi Bai International Airport Terminal 2
 8:30am - Transfer from Noi Bai International Airport to Old Quarter (https://bit.ly/46O24Az)
 9:30am - Arrive hotel and leave luggage - Singita Classy Boutique Hotel and Travel (booked through booking.com)
 10:00am - visit Cafe Giang and Bancong Cafe
 2:00pm - check in hotel then coffee date at Cong Caphe
 6:00pm - watch puppet show (https://bit.ly/3TgGyBd)
Day 2 - 8:00am - Hanoi private Tour Motorbike with Ao Dai Rental (https://bit.ly/3TmsmXL)
 2:00pm - visit Hanoi Sky Lotte Observation Deck (https://bit.ly/3uSCWLS)
Day 3 - 10:00am - cafe hopping, food trip and massage day
 9:00pm - travel to Sapa via sleeper bus (https://bit.ly/3NisdAy)
Day 4 -4:00am - arrive in Sapa and early check-in (Eden Boutique Hotel and Spa- booked through booking.com)
 11:00am - check Sapa town
 2:30pm - start tour for Silver Waterfall and Cloud Dragon Skywalk (https://bit.ly/41aXnzH)
 6:00pm - dinner and rest
Day 5 -8:00am - Sun World Fansipan Legend Ticket (https://bit.ly/4afiDIL)
 1:00pm - explore Sapa Lake
Day 6 - 8:00am- Cat Cat Village Half Day Tour (https://bit.ly/3GB831a)
 check out hotel and leave luggage at front desk
 2:00pm - check in at Viettrekking Sapa, book here: https://www.instagram.com/viettrekking.sapa/
Day 7 - 8:00am - take pictures and videos of the hotel
 12:00nn - check out hotel and leave luggage at front desk
 1:00pm - explore Sapa Town further
 4:00pm - take bus to Hanoi
Day 8 - travel back to Manila

For your Klook bookings, use our code JENB5OFF and RNZ5OFF to get discount

#sapa #vietnam #hanoi #travelguide
